history.whyExplanation: Lost on one leg: Toronto lost 121-114 at home to Orlando. Miami and Detroit both won easily.

legs.event: New Jersey Devils @ Vegas Golden Knights

history.lesson: Unders in college football blowouts are risky because the favorite can score on its own. Use unders only where both offenses are weak. The NBA under based on pace and injuries was right.

history.name: 1st-Quarter Scorers
history.whyExplanation: Lost on one leg: Brunson scored only 2 first-quarter points because he was setting up teammates (two assists). Flagg had 12, Giannis 7, and Barnes and Garland 7 each.
history.lesson: Even -1200 legs miss. Five heavy favorites stacked together still lose about 1 time in 3 to 4. Use fewer legs, and avoid players whose first-quarter role is passing.

history.name: Notre Dame 1st Quarter -7.5

legs.actual: ND 7, Navy 3 after 1Q (won the quarter by 4)

history.lesson: First-quarter spreads of 7 or more need a fast-starting offense AND an opponent that can't move the ball early. Service academies' ball-control offenses shorten the first quarter, so take the full game or 1H instead of a 1Q line against option teams.

history.lesson: NBA overs can die when one side gets blown out; pair NHL pace overs with each other rather than with an NBA over that needs both teams to score.

history.name: Best Shot $500K

history.lesson: Coin-flip road favorites (Ohio State at USC, Oklahoma State at Iowa State) and big CFB spreads (BYU -16.5) keep sinking long tickets. Road favorites in conference rivalries need cushion.

history.name: Heavy Favorites Ladder

history.lesson: Avoid 90-minute soccer moneylines in derbies and top-of-table matches (Der Klassiker): the draw is ~25% even for a big favorite. Use 'Double Chance' or draw-no-bet style markets, or leave them out.

history.name: NHL Shooters Ladder

legs.event: St. Louis Blues @ Detroit Red Wings

history.whyExplanation: Lost. MacKinnon (5), Pastrnak (4), Thompson (8) and DeBrincat (3) hit, but Matthews, Celebrini and Caufield had 2 shots each and Robertson had 1.
history.lesson: 3+ shots on goal is closer to 55-65% for most stars, not 75%; eight of them stacked is a long shot. Use 2+ SOG for ladders, or only 3+ for players averaging 4+ shots.

history.lesson: Back-to-back plus a weak goalie plus a home team with a decent offense is the best NHL team-total spot. Keep using it.

history.lesson: NBA injury unders went 1-for-4 Sunday, and every miss was a fast-paced or West Coast game. Only play NBA unders when BOTH offenses are struggling (low recent scoring), not just because players are out.

history.name: Backup Goalie Team Totals
history.whyExplanation: LOST. The Ducks leg hit (6 goals), but the Rangers managed only one goal against Edmonton's backup, so their Over 2.5 missed.
history.lesson: Pair team-total overs only when the scoring team is in good form. We hadn't checked the Rangers' own recent scoring.

history.lesson: Cushions of +9.5 or more went 2-for-2 and +7.5 missed. Set the minimum NBA cushion at +9.5, and don't back a road dog in a high-pace game.

history.name: Short-Handed Opponents
history.whyExplanation: Lost 0-3: Hawks won by only 4, Pelicans beat Memphis in OT, Washington beat Orlando outright.
history.lesson: Fading teams that just lost players (Indiana, New Orleans, Washington) failed 3-for-3; depleted rosters often play harder and the market overreacts.

history.name: NBA Big Cushions II
history.whyExplanation: Lost: Thunder +9.5 and Suns +9.5 hit, Heat +9.5 missed (lost by 21 at the Lakers).
history.lesson: Cushions still need a matchup check: Miami was on a West Coast road trip vs. a rested Lakers team.

history.name: Best Shot $500K
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 16 of 25 legs hit. Misses: Hawks -7.5, Magic +1.5, Mavericks -2.5, Grizzlies -1.5, Nuggets ML, Heat +10.5, Panthers ML, Seahawks ML, Arizona ML.
history.lesson: Monday was an upset night (7 NBA favorites lost or failed to cover). Prices of -150 to -250 are only 60-70% and should not fill a 25-leg ticket.

history.name: College Night Heavy-Favorite Ladder
history.whyExplanation: Lost: 22 of 25 hit. Misses: Brown (-410) lost to New Hampshire, Marist (-320) lost to Dartmouth, Mavericks ML (-335) lost to Sacramento.
history.lesson: Even -300 to -400 college favorites lose; Ivy/MAAC early-season games are volatile. Use -800 or longer for the heavy ladder.

history.name: Ben Shelton wins 2-0 (Set Betting)
history.whyExplanation: Hit: Shelton won 6-3, 6-4 in straight sets.
history.lesson: Big server vs. a light-hitting baseliner on a fast indoor court: straight sets was the right way to get plus money.

history.whyExplanation: Lost: Nashville won 4-1. Carolina scored only once.

history.whyExplanation: Won: all 4 legs hit (Barcelona 3-0, LASK 4-0, Inter 3-0, PSG 6-0).
history.lesson: Big class-gap UCL legs (clear favorites, -1000 or longer) are reliable; this is where soccer legs belong.

history.name: College Opening Night Locks
history.whyExplanation: Won: all 13 power-conference home favorites won, the closest by 12 (UNLV).
history.lesson: College moneylines at -1800 or longer against low-major visitors went 13-for-13; keep this as the lottery backbone.

history.whyExplanation: Lost: Ohio won by only 8 (28-20).
